segments.name: Distribution
products: Electricity sales to distributors and energy traders
Use of the main distribution and transmission grid
segments.description: Distributes electricity to captive customers and traders in Paraná concession area; operates distribution infrastructure.
segments.evidence: Our distribution business generates a large portion of its revenues by selling energy that it purchases from generation companies.

segments.name: Generation and Transmission
segments.description: Generates and transmits electricity through hydroelectric and wind facilities serving the Brazilian electric system.
segments.evidence: Our distribution, transmission and generation activities are subject to comprehensive federal, state and local legislation.

segments.name: Energy Trading
segments.description: Trades electricity and natural gas with free market customers across multiple states and neighboring countries.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, we served 1,537 free market customers through our energy trading company, across 23 states, with an average of 3.2 GW of energy traded on the CCEE.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for distributed electricity at regulated tariffs; free market customers pay for traded energy at market prices; utilities pay for transmission grid use.
revenueModel.evidence: The tariffs that we charge for the sale of electricity to captive customers are determined pursuant to a concession agreement with the Brazilian government through ANEEL.

changes.text: In 2025, Mata de Santa Genebra transmission company was consolidated into Copel GeT through strategic business combination, changing from equity method accounting to full consolidation.
changes.evidence: the consolidation of the Mata de Santa Genebra transmission company at Copel GeT, as a result of the strategic business combination.
